## Summary

Shenzhen MTC Co., Ltd. is a Shenzhen consumer-electronics manufacturer listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange main board since 10 June 2010 under code 002429 [3], with its address at the Zhaochi Innovation Industrial Park, Shenzhen [2]. The IEEE registry lists six MA-L blocks to it, the newer ones at the SHENZHEN MTC Industrial Park in Longgang District, Shenzhen [1]. MarketScreener describes its lines as smart displays (LCD and Mini LED TVs, monitors, commercial displays), the LED chain from chips through packaging to display products, and smart home networking covering communications and IoT including optical modules, and lists chairman Wei Gu as the largest shareholder at 27.86 percent [2].

Its exchange profile describes it as specialising in home audiovisual products, offering ODM and tailor-made solutions and cooperating with domestic and foreign brands, and set-top boxes that serve telecom and broadcasting operators [3]. Morningstar's profile says it manufactures and designs LCD TVs, set-top boxes, LED components, network communications terminals and internet entertainment products [4]. A MAC in these blocks is therefore most likely the network interface of a television or an operator set-top box sold under another brand, though no source in hand names a specific product [2][3].

The company's own site (szmtc.com.cn) refused connections, the FCC ID databases refused automated access, and no teardown of an MTC-built box was found, so founding year, radios, silicon and FCC grantee codes are not listed and randomization is unknown.
